name: Software Delivery
description: An Agent tests a submitted patch in the sandbox and deploys it only when the tests passed

config.instructions: The task is a JSON document {"baseCommit","patch","target":{"service","environment"}}. Test the patch on the base commit with sandbox_test. Deploy it to the target with deploy only when the tests passed, using the base commit and patch digest the test reported. Finish with {"operationId","version","patchDigest"} for the deployment, or, when the tests did not pass, finish with a failure report instead of deploying.
